verdict.rationale: Sill's own docs and README say the iPhone or iPad can click, scroll and type on the Mac. They cover taps and clicks, momentum scrolling, an on-screen trackpad, keys and typed text including Esc from an attached keyboard, Mac-style three-finger gestures, IME composition and reverse scrolling. Missing for 10: explicit mention of a physical mouse attached to the viewing device, documentation that input is injected as native OS-level events, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, mouse, keyboard, and scroll input from the viewing device lands on the host as native events
